acceptance_checks.description: Supported event types map to the documented billing kind and units.
Repeated delivery derives the same UUID5 event ID and is recorded as duplicate.
Connection and 5xx failures remain queued for visibility-timeout retry.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Payload identifiers and timestamps are copied into the billing event.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Malformed or unsupported messages are skipped and deleted.

malformed_record_policy.details: Messages missing event type, entity ID, owner ID, or timestamp are skipped.

empty_input_semantics.details: Long polling with no messages leaves all metrics unchanged.

planted_anomalies.description: Document events use snake_case while file events use camelCase.

unsupported_event_behavior: Delete the message and increment skipped.

internal_ingest.configuration: USAGE_INTERNAL_TOKEN must be set; otherwise the endpoint returns 503.
internal_ingest.unauthorized: Missing or mismatched tokens return 401 and the bridge deletes the message.
internal_ingest.unavailable: HTTP 503; bridge leaves the message queued for retry.
